Hana: Quick heads-up I pushed a tiny restructuring that splits the short-sequence batching examples into examples/batching/shortseq/. Preview shows a handful of broken snippet imports. PR #5072
Ravi: Can you paste the preview errors?
Hana: Mostly import paths in python/js snippets and one Sphinx include that references the old file. Error list (from staging):
- src/snippets/python/shortseq_demo.py -> import redwood.optimize.batch_v1 -> ModuleNotFound
- docs/includes/shortseq-playbook.rst -> includes path not found
- src/snippets/js/shortseq_example.mjs -> import from "../examples/batching_v1" -> 404

Tom: Ok small win: we can add a compatibility layer in docs build that maps old module import names to new package names using a tiny rewrite during snippet preprocessing. That avoids touching all examples immediately.
Ravi: I prefer minimal edits to source snippets so authors get correct canonical imports. Can you grep for the old module strings? I can run a fixer script to replace imports and append a one-line migration comment.
Hana: I'll run grep and paste results in 10m. Tom, what's the effort to add a preprocessor?
Tom: ~30-45m to add a Sphinx hook that rewrites snippet text when building staging. Implementation: docs/_ext/snippet_compat.py reads docs/_data/compat_map.yml and applies simple regex substitutions. Low risk.
Ravi: Sounds good. If we do both (hook + source fixes) we get safety plus a cleanup path. Plan:
- Tom: add snippet_compat hook + compat_map.yml (PR today)
- Ravi: run sed-based fixer to update python/js snippets with new imports + add migration comment (PR today)
- Hana: fix broken include in docs/includes and re-run staging preview (PR by EOD)

docs-bot: Preview published: https://staging-docs.redwood.ai/optkit/preview/5072 (5 link errors remain) :mag:

Ravi: I'll take 3 of those link errors (snippets). Tom: you take the Sphinx include one. Hana: you'll check anchor fallout for cross-team links.
Hana: Yep. Also note: the shortseq playbook mentions a recommended quant profile name "qprofile_shortseq_v1" that we renamed to "qprofiles/shortseq/default". We should add a redirect entry so old links still work.
Tom: I'll add an anchors map for the quant profile anchors to the compat_map as well. Client-side fallback is easy if fragment doesn't resolve.
Ravi: One nit: the JS snippet uses top-level await which our snippet linter flags. I'll adjust the example to use an async IIFE so it passes lint.
Hana: Great. If we over-index on compatibility the repo will get duplicate canonicals. Let's schedule a cleanup ticket to delete old paths two weeks after redirects land.
Tom: Agreed. I'll mark the hook as opt-in behind an env var so CI won't rely on it permanently.
Hana: Thanks everyone. Post grep output in this thread and I'll coordinate merges.
